registry:
  type: meta
  layer: analysis
  depends_on: []
  depended_by: [route, component, form, store, primitive]
  context_reads: [brainstorm]

  patterns:
    # --- Always patterns ---

    - id: UIC-01
      name: "Seven sub-sections in fixed order"
      when: always
      rule: |
        Emitted block contains, in this order:
        1. ### URL Contract
        2. ### ASCII Layout Map
        3. ### Component Tree
        4. ### Component Anatomy
        5. ### Data Cards
        6. ### Reuse Summary
        7. ### Hand-off
      wrong: "Missing a sub-section or reordering them"

    - id: UIC-02
      name: "Three-way name parity"
      when: always
      rule: "Every citizen name appears in ASCII Layout Map, Component Tree, AND Component Anatomy (1:1 mapping across all three; RouteShell is exempt from anatomy)"
      wrong: "ASCII shows 'PatientGrid', tree shows 'PatientListSection', anatomy missing — names diverge or coverage gaps"

    - id: UIC-03
      name: "Exactly one citizen per boundary"
      when: always
      rule: "Each node in the tree has exactly one Role from {RouteShell, Section, Component, Leaf, Dialog, Form}"
      wrong: "Node labeled 'Section/Component' (ambiguous) or missing Role"

    - id: UIC-04
      name: "Section guard"
      when: always
      rule: "A Section orchestrates ≥3 distinct sub-components OR is the sole data-fetching root of a region"
      wrong: "Labeling a standalone search input or pagination control as a Section"

    - id: UIC-05
      name: "Leaf receives props only"
      when: always
      rule: "Leaf node Data field is 'props from <Parent>' — never an SDK hook"
      wrong: "Leaf with `useGetX({ id: props.id })` (re-fetches what parent already passed)"

    - id: UIC-06
      name: "Reuse decision present"
      when: always
      rule: "Every node has Reuse.decision ∈ {reuse, promote-to-shared, create-new-shared, create-route-local} with rationale"
      wrong: "Missing decision or rationale; just `— TBD`"

    - id: UIC-07
      name: "Existing path cited on reuse/promote"
      when: always
      rule: "Nodes with decision = reuse or promote-to-shared cite the existing file path"
      wrong: "decision = reuse but no path; reader can't verify"

    - id: UIC-08
      name: "Hand-off ordering"
      when: always
      rule: "Hand-off order is Route → Store → New shared/primitive → Sections (top-down) → Leaves → Dialogs → Forms"
      wrong: "Dialogs before Sections, Forms before their parent Dialog"

    - id: UIC-09
      name: "Component Anatomy completeness"
      when: always
      rule: |
        Every citizen except RouteShell has an anatomy block containing:
        (1) root container with layout shorthand, (2) every visible slot/sub-element as one line,
        (3) primitive references inline as [primitive: <Name>] wherever an element wraps a primitive,
        (4) variants list when the citizen has visually distinct prop/URL/store-driven states.
        Forms list every field as a slot with the SDK schema field name and the primitive used.
        Dialogs show DialogHeader / DialogBody / DialogFooter structure.
      wrong: "Anatomy missing for a Leaf; or anatomy only says 'a card with stuff' without naming slots; or Form lists 'inputs' instead of named fields"

    - id: UIC-10
      name: "Anatomy is shape, not behavior"
      when: always
      rule: "Anatomy blocks describe layout, slots, sub-elements, primitives, and visual variants. They do NOT mention hooks, queries, store calls, or mutations — that lives in the Data Card."
      wrong: "Anatomy says 'IconButton calls useUpdateTax mutation' — behavior belongs in Data Card"

    - id: UIC-11
      name: "ASCII mockup required for Leaf / Component / Dialog"
      when: always
      rule: |
        Every Leaf, Component, and Dialog anatomy block contains a fenced ASCII mockup BEFORE the
        slot tree. The mockup uses Unicode box-drawing characters, ≤80 cols, with representative
        copy pulled from the source artifact (not lorem ipsum). Sections and Forms MAY omit the
        mockup (Section layout is covered by the page-level ASCII Layout Map; Forms live inside
        their Dialog's body and are shown via the parent Dialog's mockup).
      wrong: "Leaf with only a slot tree and no ASCII mockup; mockup with placeholder text like 'XXXX'"

    # --- Conditional patterns ---

    - id: UIC-C01
      name: "Dialog placement by consumer count"
      when: "the boundary is a Dialog"
      rule: "1 route consumer → routes/.../-components/<Name>Dialog/; ≥2 consumers → @/components/Dialogs/<Name>/ + barrel export added"
      wrong: "Dialog used in 1 route placed in @/components/Dialogs/ (premature shared); or used in 3 routes placed locally (duplicated)"

    - id: UIC-C02
      name: "URL state for bookmarkable selection"
      when: "boundary represents a user selection that should survive refresh (selectedId, active tab, filters, page)"
      rule: "URL r/w lists the search param; never use Zustand or useState"
      wrong: "selectedAppointmentId stored in useChatStore instead of URL search param"

    - id: UIC-C03
      name: "Zustand for shared ephemeral state"
      when: "interactive state shared between ≥2 components AND should NOT be in URL (typing, presence, draft, runtime IDs)"
      rule: "Introduce a store (route-scoped or global per location) and list it in the relevant data cards"
      wrong: "Prop-drilling typing/presence state through 3 levels; recreating local state in each consumer"

    - id: UIC-C04
      name: "useState only for ephemeral local state"
      when: "state is local to ONE component and has no sharing"
      rule: "List under Local state field of that one component's data card"
      wrong: "Filter state in useState that should be URL"

    - id: UIC-C05
      name: "ARIA on icon-only / list / dialog"
      when: "boundary is an icon-only button, a list container, or a dialog"
      rule: "ARIA field of data card lists the label (aria-label='Excluir paciente' or role='list' aria-label='Lista de pacientes')"
      wrong: "Icon-only button with no aria; list container without role + label"

    - id: UIC-C06
      name: "Promote rationale when shape repeats"
      when: "a similar shape exists in ≥2 routes' -components/"
      rule: "decision MUST be promote-to-shared, citing both routes; do not duplicate route-local"
      wrong: "PatientCard recreated in two routes when both could consume a shared PersonCard"

    - id: UIC-C07
      name: "Open Questions for unclear boundaries"
      when: "a boundary doesn't fit any citizen cleanly"
      rule: "List it under ### Open Questions with proposed classification and what info would resolve it"
      wrong: "Force-fitting an unclear boundary into Section by default"

    - id: UIC-C08
      name: "Missing primitive flagged in Hand-off"
      when: "an anatomy block references a primitive that does NOT exist in @/components/ui/"
      rule: "Hand-off MUST include a /primitive step for that primitive, ordered BEFORE the first consuming component"
      wrong: "Anatomy says [primitive: Carousel] but @/components/ui/carousel.tsx does not exist and Hand-off does not create it"

    - id: UIC-C09
      name: "Anatomy overlap triggers promote-to-shared"
      when: "two citizens have anatomies overlapping ≥70% (same root, same slot names, same primitives)"
      rule: "Reuse Summary MUST classify them as a single shared component with promote-to-shared (or create-new-shared) decision — even when only one consumer exists today"
      wrong: "Two route-local cards with identical anatomy kept separate"

  bad_practices:
    - id: bp-01
      severity: high
      name: "Section overuse"
      description: "Labeling every container as Section dilutes the orchestration signal. Section is for ≥3 distinct sub-components OR data root."
      example_wrong: "SearchInput labeled as SearchInputSection"
      example_right: "SearchInput labeled as Component (it owns URL r/w but doesn't orchestrate sub-components)"

    - id: bp-02
      severity: high
      name: "Data prop drilling"
      description: "Passing fetched data through props instead of letting each consumer fetch via React Query (which deduplicates)."
      example_wrong: "Route fetches list, passes to PatientListSection via props"
      example_right: "PatientListSection owns useListPatients; Route is a thin shell"

    - id: bp-03
      severity: high
      name: "Filter in useState"
      description: "Filters and pagination must live in URL search params so they are bookmarkable and survive refresh."
      example_wrong: "const [search, setSearch] = useState('') in a list section"
      example_right: "const { search } = routeApi.useSearch(); navigate to update"

    - id: bp-04
      severity: high
      name: "Dialog without useDialogStore"
      description: "All dialogs are opened via useDialogStore.show(<DialogComponent />). Never receive open/onOpenChange props."
      example_wrong: "<CreatePatientDialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setOpen} />"
      example_right: "show(<CreatePatientDialog />)"

    - id: bp-05
      severity: medium
      name: "Primitive duplication"
      description: "Re-implementing a primitive that already exists in @/components/ui/."
      example_wrong: "Hand-rolled <select> styled element"
      example_right: "Import Select from @/components/ui/select"

    - id: bp-06
      severity: medium
      name: "Premature shared promotion"
      description: "Moving a route-local component to @/components/<Name>/ before ≥2 consumers exist."
      example_wrong: "Creating @/components/PatientCard/ used in only one route"
      example_right: "Keep PatientCard route-local until a second route needs the same shape"

    - id: bp-07
      severity: medium
      name: "ARIA omission"
      description: "Missing aria-label on icon-only buttons, list containers, dialogs, or section landmarks."
      example_wrong: "<Button><IconTrash /></Button>"
      example_right: "<Button aria-label='Excluir paciente'><IconTrash /></Button>"

    - id: bp-08
      severity: low
      name: "ASCII map drift"
      description: "Names in ASCII map don't match Component Tree names exactly."
      example_wrong: "ASCII shows 'PatientsGrid', tree shows 'PatientListSection'"
      example_right: "Both use 'PatientListSection'"

    - id: bp-09
      severity: low
      name: "Missing Open Questions section"
      description: "Unclear boundaries silently coerced into a citizen instead of flagged for human review."
      example_wrong: "Boundary that doesn't fit cleanly labeled Section without note"
      example_right: "List under ### Open Questions with proposed classification"

  checklist:
    - "UIC-01 — seven sub-sections present in order"
    - "UIC-02 — ASCII/Tree/Anatomy name parity"
    - "UIC-03 — single citizen per boundary"
    - "UIC-04 — Section guard satisfied"
    - "UIC-05 — Leaves use props only"
    - "UIC-06 — every node has reuse decision + rationale"
    - "UIC-07 — reuse/promote nodes cite existing paths"
    - "UIC-08 — hand-off in correct order"
    - "UIC-09 — anatomy block for every citizen except RouteShell"
    - "UIC-10 — anatomy is shape only, no behavior"
    - "UIC-11 — ASCII mockup present for every Leaf / Component / Dialog"
    - "UIC-C01 — dialog placement matches consumer count"
    - "UIC-C02 — bookmarkable selection in URL"
    - "UIC-C05 — ARIA on icon-only / list / dialog"
    - "UIC-C06 — shape repeated in ≥2 routes → promote"
    - "UIC-C08 — missing primitives flagged in Hand-off"
    - "UIC-C09 — overlapping anatomies trigger promote-to-shared"
    - "bp-01..09 — no bad practice violations"
